title: Glory Be
text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

notes: The Glory Be (Gloria Patri) is a doxology, a short hymn of praise to the Trinity. It is commonly used at the end of psalms and canticles in the Divine Office and at the end of each decade of the Rosary.
